reserve.title: Need the styles later?
reserve.intro: Reserve confirmed inventory with a deposit and schedule shipment when you're ready.
reserve.step1Text: After you receive your confirmed order, choose Reserve for later delivery and tell us your requested shipping date.
reserve.step2Text: We review and approve the future reservation.
reserve.step3Text: The deposit is shown as a percentage and an amount of your confirmed order, for example: deposit due now 40%, remaining balance 60%.
reserve.step4Text: Once the deposit is confirmed, your merchandise is allocated to your order and its status becomes Reserved for later delivery.
reserve.step5Text: We send reminders before the balance is due and before your scheduled shipment.
reserve.step6Text: The remaining balance is due 7 days before the scheduled shipping date. Once full payment is confirmed, we prepare and ship your order.
reserve.changesBefore: Before the shipping documentation is issued: date changes at no cost.
reserve.changesAfter: After the shipping documentation is issued: one change at no cost; additional changes may incur administrative or logistics costs, if applicable.
reserve.terms: Full conditions are described in the Wholesale Terms.
